SITE_URL.description: Root of clx.cx for this language (short links), no trailing slash

QR_PAGES_URL.description: Base of the QR pages on clx.cx in this language (generator, extension, privacy). SITE_URL stays the site root (short links).

EXTENSION_DESCRIPTION.message: Free SVG QR code generator in your side panel: a code for any page or text, share links, embed snippets. No tracking.

GENERATE_PREVIEW_EMPTY.message: Enter data to generate QR code

SETTINGS_PRIVACY_NOTE.message: Everything runs in your browser; the extension sends nothing. A share link contains the encoded text, so anyone with the link can read it. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics.

TOAST_TOO_LONG_FOR_LINK.message: Too long for a link (max 2,048 characters) — use Copy SVG or Download

FOOTER_CLX_TITLE.message: QR code generator and short links on clx.cx

WELCOME_TAGLINE.message: Crisp SVG QR codes, right in your browser.

WELCOME_SUBTITLE.message: A QR code for any page or text — drawn locally, with no account and no tracking.

WELCOME_STEP_GENERATE_DESC.message: Open the side panel — the code for the current page is ready.

WELCOME_STEP_SHARE_DESC.message: Copy a share link or download the SVG.

WELCOME_STEP_EMBED_DESC.message: Paste an HTML, Markdown, React or Vue snippet.

WELCOME_TIP_ICON.message: Click the toolbar icon to open the side panel; pin the icon to keep it at hand.

WELCOME_TIP_PHONE.message: To open the page on your phone, point the phone’s camera at its code — no need to send yourself the link.

WELCOME_TIP_CUSTOM.message: Switch to “Custom input” to encode any text, not just the page address.

WELCOME_TIP_ECC.message: Error correction Q or H helps a printed code stay readable when it gets scratched.

WELCOME_TIP_HISTORY.message: Codes you copy with “Copy Share Link” stay in History, on your device only.

WELCOME_CLX_DESC.message: Put a short link from clx.cx into the code — it shows how many people scanned it.
